integrity: The proof directly reconstructs the weighted generating function and independently proves the dyadic dissection; finite checks corroborate but do not prove the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The result determines residues modulo eight; valuations above the third binary level and effective density rates are not claimed. The prime-representation condition is exact but is not an explicit prime-factorization test.
title: A triangular–odd-square dissection modulo eight for weighted odd excludants
